test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: On 7 March 2022, the Ministry of Women and Child Development (MoWCD), in partnership with the Ministry of Education and UNICEF, launched a landmark campaign to bring back out of school adolescent girls in India to the formal education and/or skilling system. What is the name of this campaign?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kanya Shikhsa Pravesh Utsav**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• On March 7, 2022, the **Kanya Shiksha Pravesh Utsav** campaign was started by the Ministry of Women and **Child Development** in collaboration with the Ministry of Education and UNICEF.
